name: STAR Assurance — TLE ingestion audit
summary: Differential audit of what TLE readers accept (python-sgp4, skyfield, pyorbital, Orekit) on a pinned corpus of well-formed and deliberately malformed TLEs derived from SGP4-VER; reference is the TLE format rule.
reference: NORAD/CelesTrak two-line element format: checksum mod 10 ('-' counts 1) in column 69, line numbers, satellite number columns 3-7, 69 characters; SGP4-VER TLEs (Vallado et al., AIAA 2006-6753)
reference_observed: a strict reader written from the rule scores 0 verdict errors on 203 cases; accept-all, checksum-only and misreading readers are scored exactly as constructed

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: checksum(), well_formed(), base_tles(), corpus(), run(), audit()
review.G-04: TLE text lines; inclination in degrees
review.G-06: SGP4-VER fixture with provenance (python-sgp4 2.27, MIT, sha256 in test_sgp4_audit); corpus sha256-pinned
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited reader; cases via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; readers that reject or misread a valid TLE are not validated
